cards.title: Eliminate
cards.text:
- Remove the element everyone considers essential (the hero, the product shot, the chorus, the word "love") and build around the hole.
- Remove all but one sense (only sounds, only smells).
- Cut the explanation: start after the event, end before the resolution.

cards.title: Put to another use
cards.text:
- Use the brief's product, feeling or ritual for a purpose it was never meant for.
- Make the audience's waste (leftovers, abandoned things, deleted messages) the material.
- Let the piece itself have a function in the world (a song that is also a password, an ad that is also a form to fill).

cards.title: Cheap and short-lived (Cheap short-living objects)
cards.text: Build the piece on disposable things: receipts, tickets, sticky notes, autocorrect suggestions, tea-bag tags.

cards.title: Run things in parallel (Merging)
cards.text: Make two simultaneous processes share one timeline: the breakup happens during a fire drill; the proposal happens during a software update.

cards.title: Pre-empt the objection (Preliminary anti-action)
cards.text: Open with the audience's strongest objection or cynicism and build on top of it, instead of hoping they won't think it.

cards.title: Old person, new thing
cards.text: Put a very old perspective on a very new phenomenon, or the reverse.

cards.title: Make one thing impossible
cards.text: Allow exactly one impossible element and keep everything else painfully realistic.

cards.title: What is it ashamed of?
cards.text: Every subject has an embarrassing side it hides. Lead with that side.

cards.title: Unreliable narrator
cards.text: The speaker gets one fact wrong, and the audience notices before the speaker does.

cards.title: One-word hook
cards.text: The memorable centre is a single word.

branches.label: Counter-trend and white space, tail-only verbalized sampling

cards.title: Cushion in advance (Beforehand cushioning)
cards.text: Build in the failure from the start: the hero already knows it won't work; the product admits its limit upfront.

cards.title: Keep the scaffolding
cards.text: Leave the construction visible: the draft notes, the stage directions, the counting-in.

branches.label: Outsider: conceptual blending with a foreign domain

cards.title: Speedrunning
cards.text: Splits, routing, glitches as tools, resets, frame-perfect inputs, the run that is ahead of personal best until the last level.

cards.title: Mycology
cards.text: Mycelium networks underground, the fruiting body is only a small visible part, spore prints, decomposition, symbiosis with tree roots.
